route.name: The Falls, Fire & Clockwork Loop
route.direction: west through the Berkshires, Mohawk Valley and Finger Lakes; Niagara apex; east through the Erie Canal corridor
route.summary: A foliage-season US-only loop built around private environmental art, caves, Haudenosaunee culture, glassmaking, Rochester's cult art-and-music spaces, Letchworth, Orthodox Sunday, Niagara, Buffalo architecture and the Erie Canal, with one measured anchor replacement for every day.

constraints.visa_policy: US-only route; Niagara is visited entirely from New York with no Canada border crossing or J-1 re-entry dependency.

days.theme: Glasshouse calm, private mythology and a railway-tunnel drink

lodging.preferred_area: Walkable downtown Northampton near Main and Pleasant Streets
lodging.fallback_area: Hadley near Route 9 with easy parking
lodging.room_setup: Two rooms: one 1-bed room and one 2-bed room
lodging.notes: Choose staffed, clean lodging with confirmed parking; Tunnel Bar should be walkable or a short rideshare.

days.fallback: If rental-car departure slips past 12:45, skip Smith Conservatory and protect Three Sisters before its 18:00 close.

drive.fallback: If rental-car departure slips past 12:45, skip Smith Conservatory and protect Three Sisters before its 18:00 close.

weather.station_name: HARTFORD BRADLEY INTL AP, CT US

days.theme: Factory-scale art, a peace ridge and mineral-water strangeness

lodging.fallback_area: Exit 15 hotel cluster with strong cleanliness reviews
lodging.room_setup: Two rooms: one 1-bed room and one 2-bed room
lodging.notes: Downtown is worth a modest premium because the evening remains walkable.

days.fallback: If MASS MoCA runs long, shorten Congress Park; do not rush the peace pagoda or mineral-spring circuit after dark.

drive.fallback: If MASS MoCA runs long, shorten Congress Park; do not rush the peace pagoda or mineral-spring circuit after dark.

days.theme: Underground river, Indigenous authorship and a lake-town beer reset

lodging.preferred_area: Cooperstown village center or lake edge
lodging.fallback_area: Milford/Cooperstown south with excellent cleanliness and parking
lodging.room_setup: Two rooms: one 1-bed room and one 2-bed room
lodging.notes: A small inn is welcome if both room configurations and late check-in are guaranteed.

days.fallback: If the 10:00 Howe slot is unavailable, book the earliest slot that still reaches Iroquois Museum by 15:30, or promote Secret Caverns.

drive.fallback: If the 10:00 Howe slot is unavailable, book the earliest slot that still reaches Iroquois Museum by 15:30, or promote Secret Caverns.

days.theme: America's giant hoax, rideable folklore and a taller-than-Niagara gorge

lodging.preferred_area: Downtown Ithaca/Commons with a staffed garage
lodging.room_setup: Two rooms: one 1-bed room and one 2-bed room
lodging.notes: Protect secure luggage storage because both cars remain packed until check-in.

days.fallback: The road baseline is near the cap; if departure from Fenimore is after noon, use the Taughannock overlook instead of the full gorge walk and keep Cornell optional.

drive.fallback: The road baseline is near the cap; if departure from Fenimore is after noon, use the Taughannock overlook instead of the full gorge walk and keep Cornell optional.

weather.station_name: ELMIRA CORNING RGNL AP, NY US

days.theme: A waterfall in town, molten glass and an industrial-gorge arrival

lodging.preferred_area: East End or Neighborhood of the Arts with secure parking
lodging.fallback_area: Pittsford/Brighton near I-490 with strong two-room inventory
lodging.room_setup: Keep the same two rooms for two nights
lodging.notes: Favor an area that makes Friday's museums and Radio Social a short ride.

days.fallback: If glassmaking is sold out, promote Museum of the Earth and enjoy a much shorter drive day; do not substitute a weak retail glass demo.

drive.fallback: If glassmaking is sold out, promote Museum of the Earth and enjoy a much shorter drive day; do not substitute a weak retail glass demo.

days.theme: Photography truth, maximalist art, rock archaeology and games

lodging.preferred_area: Same East End or Neighborhood of the Arts hotel
lodging.room_setup: Keep both rooms for a second night
lodging.notes: Cars stay parked after the afternoon; rideshare to Radio Social.

days.fallback: Promote The Strong if the group finds ARTISANworks plus House of Guitars too niche, or if Friday energy calls for one consensus indoor anchor.

drive.fallback: Promote The Strong if the group finds ARTISANworks plus House of Guitars too niche, or if Friday energy calls for one consensus indoor anchor.

weather.station_name: ROCHESTER GTR INTL AP, NY US

days.theme: Real market life, peak foliage, grain elevators and live music

lodging.preferred_area: Elmwood Village near Delaware/Utica with secure off-street parking
lodging.fallback_area: Downtown near Theatre District with staffed garage
lodging.room_setup: Keep the same two rooms for two nights
lodging.notes: Do not leave luggage visible; use rideshare for nightlife and stay together when moving venues.

days.fallback: Promote Eternal Flame for a shorter drive and shorter hike; at Letchworth never attempt the permanently closed Trail 7 connection.

drive.fallback: Promote Eternal Flame for a shorter drive and shorter hike; at Letchworth never attempt the permanently closed Trail 7 connection.

days.theme: Orthodox Sunday, hidden hydroelectric scale and Niagara from every level

lodging.room_setup: Keep both rooms for a second night
lodging.notes: Carry dry socks, a waterproof phone pouch and a warm layer; return to Buffalo rather than changing hotels.

days.fallback: Promote Old Fort Niagara if marine operations, wind, cold, queues or group preference makes both wet attractions poor value.

drive.fallback: Promote Old Fort Niagara if marine operations, wind, cold, queues or group preference makes both wet attractions poor value.

days.theme: Wright's opus, an abrupt presidency and an intentionally easy city night

lodging.preferred_area: Armory Square with staffed or attached parking
lodging.fallback_area: University Hill near major hotels with secure parking
lodging.room_setup: Two rooms: one 1-bed room and one 2-bed room
lodging.notes: Monday dinner options must be confirmed; do not frame this as one of the four big nights.

days.fallback: Promote Forest Lawn if the Martin House tour sells out; leave Buffalo by 12:45 because the Syracuse transfer is traffic-gated.

drive.fallback: Promote Forest Lawn if the Martin House tour sells out; leave Buffalo by 12:45 because the Syracuse transfer is traffic-gated.

days.theme: Canal machinery, glacial sand dunes and a clash of capitol architecture

lodging.preferred_area: East Greenbush/Rensselaer near US-4 and I-90
lodging.fallback_area: Downtown Albany only if final-day live routing remains below cap
lodging.room_setup: Two rooms: one 1-bed room and one 2-bed room
lodging.notes: This practical east-side lodging placement is what keeps both final road days legal.

days.fallback: The OSRM baseline is exactly 210 minutes. Leave Syracuse on time, replace Pine Bush with Stockade only if live ETA passes, and drop the Capitol walk before exceeding the cap.

drive.fallback: The OSRM baseline is exactly 210 minutes. Leave Syracuse on time, replace Pine Bush with Stockade only if live ETA passes, and drop the Capitol walk before exceeding the cap.

days.theme: Quarry sculpture, one last slow breath and a protected airport return

lodging.room_setup: Two rooms: one 1-bed room and one 2-bed room
lodging.notes: Airport convenience and clean two-room inventory take priority over Boston sightseeing.

days.fallback: This is live-traffic-gated. Promote Six Depot or skip the West Stockbridge stop entirely if the live estimate would exceed 210 minutes; the airport deadline wins.

The New York State Capitol 14:00 guided tour is incompatible with the Pine Bush timing; the core card promises only the public plaza/exterior.
